title: One iwi page of Te Kāhui Māngai (www.tkm.govt.nz/iwi/<slug>/, HTML)

landmarks: div#introBox with a region link (/region/<slug>/) and <h1> the iwi
div#iwiRohe with dl.authority_tree (dt Regional Council | Territorial Authority, dd each authority)
div#iwiHapu: an <h4> rohe heading before each table.haputable, heads Hapū | Marae | Wharenui | Location (or no Hapū column)

div#iwiOrganisations:

kind of organisation, then per organisation

name, 'Last updated: dd/mm/yyyy', role flags as

…> text [ bracket ]

, and Label: value paragraphs

signals_note: Walked from the region maps; 117 iwi on 22 October 2026. Recognised by both div#iwiHapu and div#iwiOrganisations and an <h1> under introBox, never by the address alone.
notes: Each organisation's entry prints a chair, a chief executive, an RMA contact (named people) with phone, mobile and email, and the organisation's postal and physical address: never read (hard limit 15). Roles by image: posttreaty (post-settlement governance entity [its Act, or 'Deed of Settlement signed with the Crown on …']), tree (a governance entity in the Central North Island Forests collective), treaty (mandate for settlement negotiations [an agreement in principle]), mfa (Māori Fisheries Act 2004: mandated or recognised iwi organisation), iao (iwi aquaculture organisation), rma (RMA consultation, or a group representing hapū for the RMA), tuhono. A blank Hapū cell repeats the row above's hapū. Hapū and marae have no pages of their own.
applies_to: Te Kāhui Māngai iwi pages, from 22 October 2026
process: Recognise the page; set it aside whole if not the shape.
The iwi from the heading; its region and its rohe's authorities.
Each hapū table row: hapū (blank = the row above's), marae, wharenui, location; one hapū per iwi and name; one marae per name and location across the site.
Each organisation: name, the <h2> above it, the six labels kept, role flags as printed; a post-settlement flag makes it a governance entity and names its settlement.
Every other label counted by its name only.
gates: Every iwi the region maps and authority lists link is read (check.py).
No value shaped like an email or a phone number on any row.
Every governance entity names a settlement; every role flag has a rule.
on_fail: set the page aside whole; publish nothing that check.py holds red
